# Links with destinations

[text](https://example.com) and [fragment](#links-with-destinations).

[full][site], [site][] and [site].

Images may be empty: ![alt](#) and ![alt]().

[Hash] differs in case from its definition, so markdownlint does not look it up.

<https://example.com> and https://example.com are autolinks.

[site]: https://example.com
[hash]: #
